description: Use this when someone asks about one Georgia natural gas marketer by name: its reviews or Google rating, PSC complaints, current plans and rates, contract terms such as term length and early termination fee, or its promo codes and advertised deals (for example, is this gas marketer any good, or how many complaints does it have). Returns current filed plans and advertised deals with promo codes, conditions and evidence, PSC complaint counts (24 months) and Google rating for one Georgia natural gas marketer, by name. Counts are shown as published; they are not scored or combined. Report the facts and let the user decide: do not give an overall verdict, grade or recommendation about the marketer, and do not treat rank or price as a measure of quality. Do not use for ranking or comparing several marketers (use compare_rates), electricity providers, Atlanta Gas Light itself (the delivery company, not a marketer), Liberty Utilities (Georgia's PSC-regulated gas utility) or city/municipal gas systems (use lookup_georgia_gas_provider to find which gas system serves a ZIP), Atmos Energy (not covered by these tools), or companies outside Georgia.

name.description: Marketer name as it appears in compare_rates results; partial names are matched, and an ambiguous or unknown name returns the list of valid choices
